name: Old Age
overview: Scripture portrays old age as a stage of life marked by dignity, experience, and divine blessing. Genesis 15:15 promises a peaceful death and burial in a good old age, while Moses' life in Deuteronomy 34:7 exemplifies strength and clarity even at 120 years. The respect due to the elderly is commanded in Leviticus 19:32, emphasizing honor for the hoary head. Meanwhile, 2 Samuel 19:34-35 reveals the limitations that come with advanced years, as Barzillai acknowledges his aging and diminished capacities, highlighting the balance between honor and the realities of old age.
